name: Police Explorers (Post 275)
what_you_do: Learn from Tampa police officers. Get hands on practice in law enforcement. Build leadership and teamwork. Finish volunteer hours in the community.
who_can_apply: Students ages 14 to 20, per the department FAQ.
deadline_text: The department says it is accepting applications now. You ask for an application after four visits.
how_to_apply: Visit the post for your first visit; after the fourth visit ask for an application; then an oral interview with Post 275 staff. Call 813-367-8671.
notes: The FAQ says the program is run by the rules of the Boy Scouts of America. It points to the Learning for Life Exploring Program. The page says the department is taking applications now.
